manifest.name: Printer mods
manifest.description: A Printer mods table: each upgrade or change you make to a printer, linked to the printer it is installed on and to the parts it uses. The printer lists what it has installed and each part what uses it.
manifest.author: Cobblr community
manifest.changelog: First release: a Printer mods table; each mod links to the printer it is installed on and the parts it uses, and both show the link.

provides_instances.hint: upgrades and changes to your printers, and the parts they use

field_defs.name: mod_source
field_defs.help: Where the design or instructions are: a model page, a forum thread.
